Add bounded execution observability projections

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: FWN-58
  description: |-
    Introduce transport-neutral Attempt and Operation observability query contracts with bounded, scope-bound cursors and typed durable timeline records.
    
    Implement PostgreSQL Attempt list/detail, Operation list/detail, and chronological timeline projections by reusing the existing agent execution read model and joining durable Attempt, Operation, Attention, finalization, and cleanup event sources.
